method: Manual visual body/crown-to-sole calibration, actual alpha bounds in normalized and inverse-mapped immutable native PNGs. Renderer metadata only. Same-source ratios preserve posture; density changes explicitly use comparable pose bridges. No anatomy or PNG edit.

Its crown/soles define the axis; held weapons do not extend above crown or below soles in the selected calibration poses. Native alpha>24 ROIs are read from immutable source PNGs. One common native density per source preserves real bends and kneels; the whole cell scales around baseline244 without body edits.
